keyLimits.en: Candidate sourcing, ATS, unlimited active jobs, HRIS, onboarding, time off management; video interviews/assessments/texting are paid add-ons ($39-$109/month); scoped for companies of 1-20 employees before scaling.
Adds texting, video interviews, assessments, and performance/engagement tools included (not add-ons)
Highest tier with Premier features plus Workable Agent add-on availability

addOns.name: Video interviews, assessments, texting (Standard plan only, $39-$109/month)
AI Agent credit packages (600-4,750 USD for 5,000-50,000 credits; 3,000 credits included free on all plans, expire after 1 year)

cautions.en: Pricing is tied to total company employee headcount rather than a per-seat ATS user count; the fetched page did not clearly show annual-discount math beyond the plan totals given.

Third-party listings and the seed data reference a lower-priced 'Starter' plan around $149/month that was not visible on the pricing page fetched in this session; this may be an outdated or region-specific plan name. See conflicts.

capabilities.en: Applicant tracking system (ATS) with unlimited active job postings and AI-assisted candidate sourcing.
Built-in HR information system (HRIS), onboarding, and time-off management.
Video interviews, skills assessments, and candidate texting (included or as paid add-ons depending on plan).

limitations.en: No permanent free plan; only a 15-day trial before payment is required.
Video interviews, assessments and texting are gated as paid add-ons on the entry Standard plan.

reason.en: HR platform with recruiting/ATS features competing for the same small-to-mid company hiring workflow.
Zoho's recruiting suite competes directly with Workable's ATS and hiring tools.

missingAlternatives.reason: Major direct ATS competitor to Workable, not present in the catalogue.

missingAlternatives.reason: Well-known ATS and recruiting CRM competitor to Workable, not present in the catalogue.

unknowns: A 'Starter' plan around $149/month referenced in the seed data was not visible on the current pricing page (only Standard $299, Premier $599, Enterprise $719 were shown); could be discontinued, renamed, or region-gated.
Whether the listed monthly prices differ from true annual-billing per-month equivalents was not fully clarified on the fetched page.
conflicts: Seed data lists an entry 'Starter' plan at $149/month, but the official pricing page fetched in this session shows Standard as the entry tier at $299/month with no $149 option visible.
